newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine '97 budget passed, $3.48 bln deficit.
newsitem.headline: Argentine '97 budget passed, $3.48 bln deficit.

text.p: Argentina's Senate Wednesday approved 1997's budget, which includes $43.94 billion in expenditures and a $3.48 billion deficit.
The bill had already been approved by the lower house of Congress and now only needs to be signed by President Carlos Menem to become law.
The expected $3.48 billion shortfall compares with a $3.0 billion 1997 fiscal deficit agreed with the International Monetary Fund.
Earlier Wednesday the Economy Ministry said the country posted a fiscal deficit of $843.4 million in November.

While no official cumulative figures were provided, an analyst said the November data took the deficit in the January-November period to $5.33 billion -- close to the $6.0 billion shortfall target for the entire 1996.
